name: Caption overlay
purpose: Word-timed captions as an overlay on the full frame: a preset per style system (font, size, plate, highlight, entrance) and a lane per section (hook mid, body lower, upper on request).

inputs.name: cues
inputs.description: [{start, end, text, words?, role?, lane?}] non-overlapping; `studio.py captions` writes them with roles, lanes and emphasised words

inputs.name: options.preset
inputs.description: Optional: {id, enter, roles}; default window.STUDIO_CAPTION_PRESET written into src/captions.js

layout_notes: Overlay, not a reserved band. Lower lane bottom edge follows --safe-bottom (portrait 76.6 %); mid 64 %; upper 14 % (portrait), 8 % (landscape), 10 % (square). Each caption carries data-layout-allow-caption-zone. Design: docs/caption-design.md, specs/caption-presets.json.
validation_steps: npx hyperframes check on the render host

validation.evidence: Runtime 1.3.0: five presets in portrait and clean-plate in landscape checked as HyperFrames snapshots of a scratch project on the Apple M2 host, 2026-11-07 (fonts load, lanes land where specified, emphasis and spoken-word highlight work); tests/test-short-form.py checks the CSS against the spec. Not yet rendered in a full studio.py build, so not approved.
